description: The MCA additional fee or statutory penalty for a late company or LLP filing in India: AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, INC-20A, LLP Form 8, LLP Form 11. Returns the figure or multiplier with days late, the legal source, and the consequence of not filing.

due_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the filing was due

filing_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When it will actually be filed (today if filing now)

llp_size.description: LLP Form 8/11 only: 'small' = small LLP under s.2(1)(ta), LLP Act 2008 (contribution up to Rs 25 lakh and turnover up to Rs 40 lakh in the preceding financial year), else 'other'

name: mca_late_fee
title: MCA late filing fee
